entries.collocations: exclusive of（不包括）；常考合約與會員獨享權益。 ｜ 延伸語塊：exclusive access to（專屬使用權；exclusive to = restricted to）
entries.trap_note: exclusive of（不包括）；常考合約與會員獨享權益。 ｜ 副詞形式為 exclusively！
entries.example: Platinum cardholders enjoy exclusive access to the airport VIP lounge, which is exclusive of guest pass fees.
entries.example_zh: 白金卡持卡人享有專屬使用機場貴賓室的權益，且該權益不包含隨行賓客入場通行證費用。

entries.collocations: prominent figure（知名人士、政要）。
entries.trap_note: prominent figure（知名人士、政要）。
entries.example: Dr. Evelyn Sato, a prominent macroeconomist, will deliver the opening keynote address at the Zurich summit.
entries.example_zh: 著名總體經濟學家佐藤博士將在蘇黎世高峰會發表開幕主題演講。

entries.collocations: complimentary breakfast / beverage（聽力高頻：換成 free）。
entries.trap_note: complimentary breakfast / beverage（聽力高頻：換成 free）。
entries.example: All conference registrants are entitled to a complimentary buffet breakfast and high-speed Wi-Fi at the venue.
entries.example_zh: 所有會議報名者皆有權在會場享受免費自助早餐與高速無線網路。

entries.collocations: 對比：sufficient (adj. 充足的)；衍生：deficit (n. 赤字、虧損)。
entries.trap_note: 對比：sufficient (adj. 充足的)；衍生：deficit (n. 赤字、虧損)。
entries.example: The safety audit revealed that the warehouse ventilation system was severely deficient in air-filtration capacity.
entries.example_zh: 工安稽核顯示，該倉庫的通風系統在空氣過濾效能上嚴重不足。

entries.collocations: 句型：It is imperative that + S + (should) 原形動詞。
entries.trap_note: 句型：It is imperative that + S + (should) 原形動詞。 ｜ 後面接 (should) + 原形動詞！
entries.example: It is imperative that all international shipping manifests be verified before the cargo vessel departs.
entries.example_zh: 所有國際貨運艙單必須在貨船啟航前完成查核，這點至關重要。

entries.collocations: 例：ascertain the cause of delay；衍生：certain (adj. 確定的)。
entries.trap_note: 例：ascertain the cause of delay；衍生：certain (adj. 確定的)。
entries.example: Forensic accountants were retained to ascertain the exact cause of the third-quarter inventory discrepancy.
entries.example_zh: 公司聘請鑑識會計師查明第三季存貨帳目不一致的確切原因。

entries.collocations: ⚠️ **混淆陷阱**：勿混淆 discrete (adj. 個別分開的、不連續的)。
entries.trap_note: ⚠️ **混淆陷阱**：勿混淆 discrete (adj. 個別分開的、不連續的)。
entries.example: Executive recruiters must remain strictly discreet when approaching senior candidates from competing firms.
entries.example_zh: 高階獵人頭顧問在接觸競爭對手公司的資深候選人時，必須保持嚴格保密與謹慎。

entries.collocations: 衍生動詞：accumulate (v. 累積、積累)。
entries.trap_note: 衍生動詞：accumulate (v. 累積、積累)。
entries.example: The accumulative effect of minor assembly-line delays resulted in a significant production backlog.
entries.example_zh: 裝配線微小延誤的累積效應，導致了嚴重的生產積壓。

entries.collocations: 常見於科技、文化或市場影響力主題（如 pervasive technology）。
entries.trap_note: 常見於科技、文化或市場影響力主題（如 pervasive technology）。
entries.example: With cloud-based collaboration tools becoming pervasive across the industry, remote auditing is now standard practice.
entries.example_zh: 隨著雲端協作工具在業界無處不在，遠端審計已成為標準作業流程。

entries.collocations: 衍生：conscientious (adj. 盡責的)、conscience (n. 良心)。
entries.trap_note: 衍生：conscientious (adj. 盡責的)、conscience (n. 良心)。
entries.example: Ms. Lin conscientiously reviewed every clause of the vendor agreement before authorizing the wire transfer.
entries.example_zh: 林女士在授權電匯前，認真細緻地審查了供應商協議的每一項條款。

entries.collocations: 衍生：negligently (adv. 疏忽地)、negligence (n. 過失、玩忽職守)。
entries.trap_note: 衍生：negligently (adv. 疏忽地)、negligence (n. 過失、玩忽職守)。
entries.example: Tenants who neglect to submit their lease renewal forms thirty days in advance may forfeit their security deposit.
entries.example_zh: 若房客未提前三十天提交租約續約表單，可能會被沒收押金。

entries.collocations: 等同於 afterward；常用於商業事件流程與時間軸轉折。
entries.trap_note: 等同於 afterward；常用於商業事件流程與時間軸轉折。
entries.example: The prototype initially failed thermal testing; subsequently, the engineering team redesigned the cooling fan.
entries.example_zh: 該原型機最初未通過散熱測試；隨後，工程團隊重新設計了冷卻風扇。

entries.collocations: 片語：in succession（連續地）；形容詞：successive（連續的）。
entries.trap_note: 片語：in succession（連續地）；形容詞：successive（連續的）。
entries.example: After winning the industry quality award for four years in succession, the plant expanded its production capacity.
entries.example_zh: 在連續四年榮獲業界品質大獎後，該工廠進一步擴充了其生產產能。

entries.collocations: 片語：in close proximity to（鄰近某地）；approximate (adj. 大約的)。 ｜ 延伸語塊：geographic proximity（地理上的鄰近性；proximity = nearness = vicinity）
entries.trap_note: 片語：in close proximity to（鄰近某地）；approximate (adj. 大約的)。 ｜ 固定搭配 in close proximity to！ ｜ 名詞作主詞！
entries.example: Located in close proximity to the central rail terminal, the new office complex attracts top regional talent.
entries.example_zh: 新辦公大樓座落於鄰近中央鐵路客運總站之處，吸引了頂尖的區域專業人才。

entries.collocations: exposure to foreign markets（進軍國際市場的曝光度）。
entries.trap_note: exposure to foreign markets（進軍國際市場的曝光度）。
entries.example: Sponsoring the international marathon gave our sportswear brand extensive media exposure across Europe.
entries.example_zh: 贊助國際馬拉松賽事，為我們的運動品牌在全歐洲帶來了廣泛的媒體曝光度。

entries.collocations: 多益 Part 3/4/7 會議、展覽、研討會最高頻地點詞。
entries.trap_note: 多益 Part 3/4/7 會議、展覽、研討會最高頻地點詞。
entries.example: Due to overwhelming ticket demand, organizers relocated the trade symposium to a larger downtown venue.
entries.example_zh: 由於購票需求極度熱烈，主辦單位將商務研討會移至市中心更大的會場舉行。

entries.collocations: 同義改寫：launch, reveal, introduce（常考新產品/服務上市）。 ｜ 使用者弱點語塊：unveil the cutting-edge consumer electronics device (發表頂尖消費電子裝置)
entries.trap_note: 同義改寫：launch, reveal, introduce（常考新產品/服務上市）。 ｜ ⚠️ 弱點備忘：多益新產品發表與戰略藍圖公布必考字（unveil new initiatives）。
entries.example: The automaker plans to unveil its next-generation autonomous delivery van at the Frankfurt Motor Show.
entries.example_zh: 這家汽車製造商計畫在法蘭克福車展上正式推出其下一代自駕外送貨車。

entries.collocations: 如 autonomous vehicles（自動駕駛車）。
entries.trap_note: 如 autonomous vehicles（自動駕駛車）。
entries.example: Each regional subsidiary operates as an autonomous business unit while adhering to corporate financial guidelines.
entries.example_zh: 各區域子公司皆作為獨立自主的業務單位運作，同時嚴格遵守總部財務準則。

entries.collocations: 用於補充說明前方名詞（＝that is to say）。
entries.trap_note: 用於補充說明前方名詞（＝that is to say）。
entries.example: Only two departments exceeded their quarterly cost-reduction targets, namely Procurement and Logistics.
entries.example_zh: 僅有兩個部門超越了其季度成本精簡目標，即採購部與物流部。

entries.collocations: 文法重點：後方常接分詞構句 thereby + V-ing（如 thereby cutting costs）。
entries.trap_note: 文法重點：後方常接分詞構句 thereby + V-ing（如 thereby cutting costs）。
entries.example: The firm consolidated three regional warehouses into a single automated hub, thereby cutting transit costs by 22%.
entries.example_zh: 該公司將三個區域倉庫整併為單一自動化物流樞紐，從而降低了22%的運輸成本。

entries.collocations: 等同於 nevertheless；副詞轉折語，不具連接兩子句之功能。
entries.trap_note: 等同於 nevertheless；副詞轉折語，不具連接兩子句之功能。
entries.example: The construction project encountered severe inclement weather in March; nonetheless, the contractor finished on schedule.
entries.example_zh: 該項工程專案在三月遭遇了嚴峻的惡劣天候；儘管如此，承包商仍如期完工。

entries.collocations: 等同於 rather, slightly。
entries.trap_note: 等同於 rather, slightly。
entries.example: Although third-quarter retail sales were somewhat lower than projected, annual net profit reached a record high.
entries.example_zh: 儘管第三季零售銷售額略低於預期目標，但全年淨利潤仍創下歷史新高。

entries.collocations: terminate a contract（終止合約）；termination notice。
entries.trap_note: terminate a contract（終止合約）；termination notice。
entries.example: Either party may initiate contract termination by providing sixty days' written notice to the other party.
entries.example_zh: 任何一方均可藉由向對方提供六十天的書面通知，正式啟動終止合約程序。

entries.collocations: confidentiality clause（保密條款）；escape clause（免責條款）。
entries.trap_note: confidentiality clause（保密條款）；escape clause（免責條款）。
entries.example: Our legal counsel inserted a penalty clause into the supply contract to protect against late deliveries.
entries.example_zh: 我們的法律顧問在供應合約中加入了一項罰則條款，以防範交貨延遲之風險。

entries.collocations: 對比連接詞，後方接完整子句表兩者對比（S + V whereas S + V）。
entries.trap_note: 對比連接詞，後方接完整子句表兩者對比（S + V whereas S + V）。
entries.example: Domestic sales of desktop computers declined by five percent, whereas enterprise cloud subscriptions surged.
entries.example_zh: 桌上型電腦的國內銷售量下滑了5%，反之企業雲端訂閱服務則大幅激增。

entries.collocations: 轉折副詞，前後需使用句號或分號隔開，不可直接當連接詞用。 ｜ 延伸語塊：however difficult（無論多麼困難；however difficult = no matter how difficult）
entries.trap_note: 轉折副詞，前後需使用句號或分號隔開，不可直接當連接詞用。 ｜ however + 形容詞/副詞 + S + V 表示『無論多麼……』！
entries.example: The proposed software upgrade offers enhanced security; however, it is not compatible with older terminals.
entries.example_zh: 提議的軟體升級功能強化了安全性；然而，它與舊型終端設備無法相容。

entries.collocations: 連接詞表雖然；放在句尾時為副詞表「然而、不過」。 ｜ 延伸語塊：as though it were（彷彿宛如；as though = as if）
entries.trap_note: 連接詞表雖然；放在句尾時為副詞表「然而、不過」。 ｜ as though 常接虛擬語氣 were！
entries.example: Though the initial investment was substantial, the solar array paid for itself within three fiscal years.
entries.example_zh: 儘管初期投資金額相當龐大，但太陽能陣列系統在三個會計年度內便已完全回收成本。

entries.collocations: 等同於 as though，引導方式或假設子句。
entries.trap_note: 等同於 as though，引導方式或假設子句。
entries.example: The newly renovated lobby looks as if it were designed by an award-winning contemporary architect.
entries.example_zh: 全新翻修的接待大廳看起來宛如出自獲獎當代建築大師之手。

entries.collocations: 兩個單詞，接完整子句表讓步（非合體字）。
entries.trap_note: 兩個單詞，接完整子句表讓步（非合體字）。
entries.example: Even though raw material prices fluctuated wildly, the manufacturer maintained stable wholesale pricing.
entries.example_zh: 即使原物料價格劇烈波動，該製造商仍維持了穩定的批發銷售定價。

entries.collocations: 介系詞片語，後接名詞或 V-ing（如 regardless of inclement weather）。
entries.trap_note: 介系詞片語，後接名詞或 V-ing（如 regardless of inclement weather）。
entries.example: All visitors must present photo identification at the security desk, regardless of their corporate title.
entries.example_zh: 所有訪客進入警衛安全櫃檯時，不論其企業職位高低，皆必須出示附照片之身分證件。

entries.collocations: 接子句；對比介系詞片語 in the event of + N。 ｜ 延伸語塊：in the event that（萬一 / 如果發生……；in the event that = if = in case）
entries.trap_note: 接子句；對比介系詞片語 in the event of + N。 ｜ 視覺錨點：in the event that 後接完整句子 S+V；in the event of 後接名詞！
entries.example: In the event that the primary server experiences an outage, backup systems will activate within five seconds.
entries.example_zh: 萬一主伺服器發生中斷故障，備援系統將於五秒鐘內自動啟動接手。

entries.collocations: 片語：at one's discretion（由某人自行斟酌裁奪）。 ｜ 延伸語塊：use one's discretion（行使自身裁量權；discretion = judgment = authority） ｜ 延伸語塊：at the discretion of（由……自行斟酌決定；at the discretion of = determined by）
entries.trap_note: 片語：at one's discretion（由某人自行斟酌裁奪）。 ｜ 形容詞形式為 discretionary（自由裁量的）！ ｜ 固定商務片語！
entries.example: Department managers may approve remote-work requests at their own discretion during severe weather alerts.
entries.example_zh: 在發布嚴峻天候警報期間，部門主管可依自身裁量權核准同仁之遠距辦公申請。

entries.collocations: 財務對帳必考：discrepancy between the invoice and the records。 ｜ 延伸語塊：resolve the discrepancy（解決差異/消除不一致；discrepancy = variance = inconsistency = divergence）
entries.trap_note: 財務對帳必考：discrepancy between the invoice and the records。 ｜ discrepancy 為名詞！
entries.example: The auditor discovered a $4,200 discrepancy between the digital invoice ledger and the bank statement.
entries.example_zh: 審計人員發現數位發票帳冊與銀行對帳單之間存在四千兩百美元的金額出入不符。

entries.collocations: workplace discrimination（職場歧視）。
entries.trap_note: workplace discrimination（職場歧視）。
entries.example: Our corporate charter enforces a zero-tolerance policy regarding any form of workplace discrimination.
entries.example_zh: 我們的企業規章嚴格執行針對任何形式職場歧視的零容忍政策。

entries.collocations: 衍生名詞：persistence (n. 堅持、毅力)。
entries.trap_note: 衍生名詞：persistence (n. 堅持、毅力)。
entries.example: Despite persistent supply chain bottlenecks, the electronics division fulfilled all holiday pre-orders.
entries.example_zh: 儘管供應鏈持續面臨瓶頸挑戰，電子產品部門仍圓滿履行了所有節慶預購訂單。

entries.collocations: 範圍界定：as far as I know、as far as ... is concerned。
entries.trap_note: 範圍界定：as far as I know、as far as ... is concerned。
entries.example: As far as the quarterly marketing budget is concerned, no further expenditure can be authorized this month.
entries.example_zh: 就季度行銷預算而言，本月份已無法再核准任何額外的支出款項。

entries.collocations: 連接詞接子句，子句常伴隨情態動詞 can / may / could。
entries.trap_note: 連接詞接子句，子句常伴隨情態動詞 can / may / could。
entries.example: Please upload your presentation slides by Wednesday in order that our technical crew can test compatibility.
entries.example_zh: 請於週三前上傳您的簡報投影片，以便我們的技術團隊能事先測試相容性。

entries.collocations: 表假設性讓步（即使發生某事，結果依然……）。
entries.trap_note: 表假設性讓步（即使發生某事，結果依然……）。
entries.example: Even if the municipal permit arrives tomorrow, road repaving cannot begin until the rain subsides.
entries.example_zh: 即使市政施工許可證明日送達，在降雨平息之前仍無法展開道路重新鋪設作業。

entries.collocations: 金融貸款情境核心字（如 loan collateral）。
entries.trap_note: 金融貸款情境核心字（如 loan collateral）。
entries.example: The commercial lender required the startup to pledge its manufacturing equipment as loan collateral.
entries.example_zh: 商業放款銀行要求該新創公司將其生產製造設備抵押作為貸款擔保品。

entries.collocations: 衍生動詞：fluctuate（如 currency/price fluctuation）。
entries.trap_note: 衍生動詞：fluctuate（如 currency/price fluctuation）。
entries.example: To protect profit margins against currency fluctuation, the exporter signed fixed-rate forward contracts.
entries.example_zh: 為了防範匯率劇烈波動對利潤率造成衝擊，該出口商簽署了固定匯率遠期合約。

entries.collocations: 片語：be subject to change / approval / inspection（多益超高頻）。
entries.trap_note: 片語：be subject to change / approval / inspection（多益超高頻）。 ｜ subject 作形容詞！
entries.example: All international flight schedules and boarding gate assignments are subject to change without prior notice.
entries.example_zh: 所有國際航班時刻表與登機門安排如有變動，恕不另行個別通知。

entries.collocations: 分詞/被動：resented。
entries.trap_note: 分詞/被動：resented。
entries.example: Several senior technicians resented being excluded from the software architecture planning committee.
entries.example_zh: 數名資深技術人員因被排除在軟體架構規劃委員會之外而感到不滿不滿。

entries.collocations: 片語：confine A to B（將 A 限制在 B 範圍內）；confined (adj. 狹小的)。
entries.trap_note: 片語：confine A to B（將 A 限制在 B 範圍內）；confined (adj. 狹小的)。
entries.example: Please confine your presentation remarks to the ten-minute slot allocated on the symposium agenda.
entries.example_zh: 請將您的發言內容嚴格限制在座談會議程所分配的十分鐘時段之內。

entries.collocations: 片語：abstain from voting（投票棄權）。
entries.trap_note: 片語：abstain from voting（投票棄權）。
entries.example: Three board members abstained from voting on the merger resolution due to potential conflicts of interest.
entries.example_zh: 因潛在利益衝突考量，三位董事會成員在企業合併決議案表決中投下了棄權票。

entries.collocations: 搭配：unanimous decision / agreement / approval。
entries.trap_note: 搭配：unanimous decision / agreement / approval。
entries.example: Following two hours of deliberation, the selection committee reached a unanimous decision on the new CEO.
entries.example_zh: 歷經兩個小時的深入審議後，遴選委員會在新任執行長人選上達成了全體一致的決定。

entries.meaning: 包含在內的；具包容性的
entries.collocations: 片語：inclusive of taxes / shipping fees（包含稅金/運費）。
entries.trap_note: 片語：inclusive of taxes / shipping fees（包含稅金/運費）。
entries.example: The quoted banquet package price of $85 per guest is fully inclusive of service charges and local taxes.
entries.example_zh: 所報價的每位賓客85美元宴席套裝方案，已完全包含服務費與地方稅金。

entries.collocations: 多益生活情境高頻字。
entries.trap_note: 多益生活情境高頻字。
entries.example: To reduce plastic waste, the restaurant chain now offers a ten-percent discount on takeout orders using reusable containers.
entries.example_zh: 為了減少塑膠廢棄物，該連鎖餐廳現對使用環保容器的外帶訂單提供九折優惠。

entries.collocations: courier service（快遞服務，聽力 Part 3/4 改寫常用詞）。
entries.trap_note: courier service（快遞服務，聽力 Part 3/4 改寫常用詞）。
entries.example: Sensitive legal contracts must be dispatched via an insured overnight courier rather than standard mail.
entries.example_zh: 機密的法律契約必須透過投保之隔日送達快遞遞送，而非一般平信郵寄。

entries.collocations: 市政公告、通勤通知、交通改道情境高頻。
entries.trap_note: 市政公告、通勤通知、交通改道情境高頻。
