entries.meaning: 其餘的人或物；剩餘款項／時間
entries.collocations: the remainder of the payment / meeting
entries.trap_note: ⚠️ 易混淆陷阱：切勿與 remains（遺體、歷史遺蹟、殘渣）混淆！表合約剩餘款項或會議剩餘時間一律用 the remainder。
entries.example: The keynote lecture will occupy the first hour, and the remainder of the morning will be devoted to workshops.
entries.example_zh: 主題演講將占用上午第一個小時的時間，而上午其餘剩餘的寶貴時間將全數投入於專案實作工作坊。

entries.collocations: within reach of the annual target
entries.trap_note: ⚠️ 易混淆陷阱：反義片語為 out of reach（遙不可及、能力所不及）。
entries.example: With fourth-quarter pre-orders exceeding expectations, our annual sales milestone is now well within reach.
entries.example_zh: 隨著第四季度的預購訂單表現遠超原先預期，我們全年度的營收突破目標里程碑如今已然觸手可及。

entries.meaning: 總計共達……（後接金額或數量）
entries.collocations: a combined total of $5 million
entries.trap_note: ⚠️ 易混淆陷阱：固定商業搭配詞，切勿誤選非正規搭配 combined totaling。
entries.example: The three regional charity galas raised a combined total of four hundred thousand dollars for children's hospitals.
entries.example_zh: 這三場在不同區域舉辦的慈善募款晚宴，總計為市立兒童綜合醫院共同募集了高達四十萬美元的愛心善款。

entries.meaning: 兩者皆然、一視同仁（置於 A and B 之後）
entries.collocations: customers and employees alike
entries.trap_note: ⚠️ 易混淆陷阱：A and B alike 置於兩個對等名詞之後；like A and B 則置於名詞之前。
entries.example: The new ergonomic office chairs have received enthusiastic feedback from executives and administrative staff alike.
entries.example_zh: 這款全新引進的人體工學辦公座椅，獲得了高階主管以及基層行政同仁雙方全體一致的高度肯定與讚賞。

entries.collocations: oversee = supervise = manage
entries.trap_note: 注意：oversight 是名詞，指『疏忽 / 遺漏』！
entries.example: Ms. Lin was appointed to oversee the project due to her extensive management experience.
entries.example_zh: 由於林女士具備豐富的管理經驗，她被指派負責監督這項專案。

entries.collocations: oversight = mistake = omission
entries.trap_note: 核心替換：oversight = mistake = omission
entries.example: Due to an unfortunate oversight, the revised invoice was sent to the wrong vendor.
entries.example_zh: 由於一個令人遺憾的疏忽，修訂後的發票被寄給了錯誤的供應商。

entries.collocations: eligible for = qualified for ｜ 延伸語塊：eligible for promotion（符合晉升資格；eligible for = qualified for）
entries.trap_note: 必考介系詞：eligible 後方固定搭配 for + 名詞！ ｜ eligible 後接 for！
entries.example: Only full-time staff who complete the leadership workshop are eligible for promotion.
entries.example_zh: 只有完成領導力工作坊的全職員工，才符合晉升拔擢的資格。

entries.collocations: entitled to = have the right to
entries.trap_note: 必考介系詞：be entitled to + 名詞 / 原形動詞
entries.example: Customers receiving damaged items are entitled to a refund within 14 business days.
entries.example_zh: 收到瑕疵損壞商品的顧客，有權在十四個營業日內申請全額退款。

entries.collocations: exempted from = excused from
entries.trap_note: 必考介系詞：exempted 後方固定搭配 from！
entries.example: Attendees registering before Friday are automatically exempted from the fee.
entries.example_zh: 在星期五前報名註冊的與會者，將自動獲得免除此筆會議費用的優惠。

entries.collocations: compatible with = adaptable to = work with ｜ 延伸語塊：compatible with the system（與該系統相容；compatible with = adaptable to）
entries.trap_note: 必考介系詞：compatible 固定搭配 with！ ｜ compatible 後接 with！
entries.example: Please verify that the software update is compatible with the operating system.
entries.example_zh: 請務必確認該項軟體更新能與既有的電腦作業系統完全相容。

entries.collocations: under the direction of = under the leadership of
entries.trap_note: 核心替換：under the direction of = under the leadership of
entries.example: The new research lab was constructed under the direction of Dr. Morales.
entries.example_zh: 這座全新的科研實驗室是在莫拉萊斯博士的指導領導之下規劃建造的。

entries.collocations: proceed = continue = go ahead
entries.trap_note: 易混淆：proceed (v.) 繼續進行 vs. procedure (n.) 程序步驟！
entries.example: Engineers were advised to proceed with caution during the structural inspection.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「謹慎繼續進行」於職場之情境：Engineers were advised to proceed with caution during the structural inspection.

entries.collocations: procedure = protocol = routine
entries.trap_note: 核心替換：procedure = protocol = routine
entries.example: Employees must adhere to the standard operating procedure when handling toxic chemicals.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「標準作業程序 (SOP)」於職場之情境：Employees must adhere to the standard operating procedure when handling toxic chemicals.

entries.collocations: consist of = be composed of = comprise
entries.trap_note: 必考用法：consist of 永遠沒有被動態 (is consisted of ❌)！
entries.example: The executive training program consists of five rigorous modules.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「由五個模組組成」於職場之情境：The executive training program consists of five rigorous modules.

entries.collocations: persist in = continue steadfastly
entries.trap_note: 介系詞搭配：persist 固定接 in！
entries.example: The sales team persisted in efforts despite facing severe market contraction.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「堅持不懈地努力」於職場之情境：The sales team persisted in efforts despite facing severe market contraction.

entries.collocations: insist on = demand firmly
entries.trap_note: 介系詞搭配：insist 固定接 on！
entries.example: The safety auditor insisted on immediate compliance with environmental standards.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「堅持要求合規」於職場之情境：The safety auditor insisted on immediate compliance with environmental standards.

entries.collocations: prior to = before = ahead of ｜ 延伸語塊：prior to departure（在出發之前；prior to = before = ahead of）
entries.trap_note: 視覺錨點：prior to 是介系詞片語，後接名詞或 V-ing！ ｜ prior 後接 to！
entries.example: All travelers must submit visa documentation prior to departure.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「在出發之前」於職場之情境：All travelers must submit visa documentation prior to departure.

entries.collocations: delegate = assign = entrust; capably = skillfully
entries.trap_note: 核心替換：delegate = assign = entrust; capably = skillfully
entries.example: A great supervisor knows how to delegate tasks capably to team members.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「幹練地委派任務」於職場之情境：A great supervisor knows how to delegate tasks capably to team members.

entries.collocations: intent = commitment / purpose
entries.trap_note: 商務固定名詞搭配：letter of intent（意向書），不可用 intention 替換！
entries.example: Both firms signed a letter of intent to finalize the cross-border merger.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「意向書 (LOI)」於職場之情境：Both firms signed a letter of intent to finalize the cross-border merger.

entries.collocations: convention = conference = assembly
entries.trap_note: 多義字：convention 可指『大型會議/年會』或『慣例/傳統』。
entries.example: Over 3,000 delegates will gather at the annual convention center.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「年度大會中心」於職場之情境：Over 3,000 delegates will gather at the annual convention center.

entries.collocations: assess = evaluate = appraise = gauge
entries.trap_note: 核心替換：assess = evaluate = appraise = gauge
entries.example: Insurance adjusters arrived early to assess the damage caused by the storm.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「評估損失 / 災情」於職場之情境：Insurance adjusters arrived early to assess the damage caused by the storm.

entries.collocations: evaluate = estimate = analyze
entries.trap_note: 核心替換：evaluate = estimate = analyze
entries.example: The consulting firm will evaluate market potential before greenlighting the launch.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「評估市場潛力」於職場之情境：The consulting firm will evaluate market potential before greenlighting the launch.

entries.collocations: provided that = as long as = on condition that
entries.trap_note: 核心替換：provided that = as long as = on condition that
entries.example: The contract will be renewed provided that terms are met satisfactorily.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「只要符合條件」於職場之情境：The contract will be renewed provided that terms are met satisfactorily.

entries.collocations: coverage = reporting = broadcast; 多義字：coverage 亦指『保險理賠範圍』！
entries.trap_note: 核心替換：coverage = reporting = broadcast; 多義字：coverage 亦指『保險理賠範圍』！
entries.example: The tech summit received extensive media coverage across North America.
entries.example_zh: 這場科技高峰會在全北美地區獲得了各主流媒體的廣泛深度報導。

entries.collocations: recall = withdraw = call back; faulty = defective
entries.trap_note: 核心替換：recall = withdraw = call back; faulty = defective
entries.example: The distributor decided to recall faulty appliances to avoid legal liability.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「召回故障家電」於職場之情境：The distributor decided to recall faulty appliances to avoid legal liability.

entries.collocations: conditions = terms = stipulations
entries.trap_note: 核心替換：conditions = terms = stipulations
entries.example: Repairs are conducted free of charge under warranty conditions.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「在保固條件限制下」於職場之情境：Repairs are conducted free of charge under warranty conditions.

entries.collocations: in stock = available = on hand
entries.trap_note: 核心替換：in stock = available = on hand
entries.example: The warehouse strives to keep high-demand merchandise in stock.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「備有現貨庫存」於職場之情境：The warehouse strives to keep high-demand merchandise in stock.

entries.collocations: conduct = carry out = perform = execute
entries.trap_note: 核心替換：conduct = carry out = perform = execute
entries.example: The compliance division was authorized to conduct an investigation into the leak.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「執行內部調查」於職場之情境：The compliance division was authorized to conduct an investigation into the leak.

entries.collocations: promote = boost = enhance; 多義字：promote 亦指『升遷 / 提拔』！
entries.trap_note: 核心替換：promote = boost = enhance; 多義字：promote 亦指『升遷 / 提拔』！
entries.example: Digital campaigns were launched to promote brand awareness among young professionals.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「提昇品牌知名度」於職場之情境：Digital campaigns were launched to promote brand awareness among young professionals.

entries.collocations: prospective = potential = future; promising = favorable
entries.trap_note: 核心替換：prospective = potential = future; promising = favorable
entries.example: The sales representative scheduled meetings with several promising prospective clients.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「有潛力的潛在客戶」於職場之情境：The sales representative scheduled meetings with several promising prospective clients.

entries.collocations: proficient in = skilled in = fluent in
entries.trap_note: 必考介系詞：proficient 後方固定搭配 in！
entries.example: Candidates proficient in Mandarin and English are preferred for the regional role.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「精通中文」於職場之情境：Candidates proficient in Mandarin and English are preferred for the regional role.

entries.collocations: accustomed to = used to
entries.trap_note: 注意：be accustomed to 後方的 to 是介系詞，接名詞或 V-ing！
entries.example: Staff members quickly became accustomed to changes in remote work guidelines.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「習慣於各種變動」於職場之情境：Staff members quickly became accustomed to changes in remote work guidelines.

entries.collocations: resistant to = impervious to
entries.trap_note: 介系詞搭配：resistant 固定接 to！
entries.example: The new kitchen apron is made of synthetic fibers highly resistant to heat.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「耐熱的 / 抗熱的」於職場之情境：The new kitchen apron is made of synthetic fibers highly resistant to heat.

entries.collocations: vulnerable to = susceptible to = exposed to
entries.trap_note: 介系詞搭配：vulnerable 固定接 to！
entries.example: Unpatched database servers are vulnerable to cyber attacks.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「易遭受攻擊」於職場之情境：Unpatched database servers are vulnerable to cyber attacks.

entries.collocations: pertinent to = relevant to = related to
entries.trap_note: 介系詞搭配：pertinent 固定接 to！
entries.example: Please disclose all files pertinent to the ongoing patent dispute.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「與本案直接相關」於職場之情境：Please disclose all files pertinent to the ongoing patent dispute.

entries.collocations: mandate = directive = order = regulation
entries.trap_note: 多義字：mandate 可作名詞（授權/指令）亦可作動詞（強制規定）。
entries.example: The factory complied strictly with the government mandate on emission limits.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「政府的強制命令」於職場之情境：The factory complied strictly with the government mandate on emission limits.

entries.meaning: 一項蓄意/深思熟慮的企圖
entries.collocations: deliberate = intentional = calculated
entries.trap_note: 多義字：deliberate (adj.) 蓄意的/審慎的；(v.) 仔細考慮/研議。
entries.example: The firm made a deliberate attempt to capture market share in rural regions.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「一項蓄意/深思熟慮的企圖」於職場之情境：The firm made a deliberate attempt to capture market share in rural regions.

entries.collocations: in charge of = responsible for = overseeing
entries.trap_note: 核心替換：in charge of = responsible for = overseeing
entries.example: Mr. Chen was placed in charge of logistics for the Asia-Pacific territory.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「負責物流營運」於職場之情境：Mr. Chen was placed in charge of logistics for the Asia-Pacific territory.

entries.collocations: in addition to = besides = as well as
entries.trap_note: 視覺錨點：in addition to 後接名詞 / V-ing，表『除了…還有…』！
entries.example: In addition to bonuses, employees receive subsidized commuting passes.
entries.example_zh: 除了年終績效獎金之外，全體員工還可獲得公司補貼的上下班通勤交通票卡。

entries.collocations: step down = resign = retire from
entries.trap_note: 核心替換：step down = resign = retire from
entries.example: The founder announced plans to step down from the board next spring.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「辭去董事會職位」於職場之情境：The founder announced plans to step down from the board next spring.

entries.collocations: take over = assume control of
entries.trap_note: 核心替換：take over = assume control of
entries.example: A veteran manager will take over the department following the restructuring.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「接管該部門業務」於職場之情境：A veteran manager will take over the department following the restructuring.

entries.collocations: hold off on = delay = defer = postpone
entries.trap_note: 核心替換：hold off on = delay = defer = postpone
entries.example: Management decided to hold off on hiring until third-quarter forecasts improve.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「暫緩招聘新進人員」於職場之情境：Management decided to hold off on hiring until third-quarter forecasts improve.

entries.collocations: put off = postpone = defer
entries.trap_note: 核心替換：put off = postpone = defer
entries.example: Both parties agreed to put off the negotiation until legal reviews are complete.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「推遲雙邊談判會議」於職場之情境：Both parties agreed to put off the negotiation until legal reviews are complete.

entries.collocations: putting in overtime = working extra hours
entries.trap_note: 核心替換：putting in overtime = working extra hours
entries.example: Staff members were putting in overtime to meet the rigorous software rollout date.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「持續加班工作」於職場之情境：Staff members were putting in overtime to meet the rigorous software rollout date.

entries.meaning: 請勿抽煙 / 克制避免
entries.collocations: refrain from = abstain from = avoid
entries.trap_note: 必考介系詞：refrain 固定搭配 from + V-ing/N！
entries.example: Guests are kindly requested to refrain from smoking on the outdoor terrace.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「請勿抽煙 / 克制避免」於職場之情境：Guests are kindly requested to refrain from smoking on the outdoor terrace.

entries.collocations: adhere to = comply with = abide by = follow
entries.trap_note: 必考介系詞：adhere 固定搭配 to！
entries.example: All laboratory personnel must adhere to guidelines set by the safety commission.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「遵守各項準則」於職場之情境：All laboratory personnel must adhere to guidelines set by the safety commission.

entries.collocations: be bound to = be certain to = inevitable
entries.trap_note: 核心替換：be bound to = be certain to = inevitable
entries.example: With market volatility at record highs, price fluctuations are bound to happen.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「必然會發生」於職場之情境：With market volatility at record highs, price fluctuations are bound to happen.

entries.collocations: back down = yield = concede
entries.trap_note: 核心替換：back down = yield = concede
entries.example: Neither negotiating team was willing to back down from demands.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「從訴求中退讓妥協」於職場之情境：Neither negotiating team was willing to back down from demands.

entries.collocations: throughout the day = all day long
entries.trap_note: 核心替換：throughout the day = all day long
entries.example: Refreshments and snacks will be served in the foyer throughout the day.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「一整天持續不斷」於職場之情境：Refreshments and snacks will be served in the foyer throughout the day.

entries.collocations: vice versa = the reverse is also true
entries.trap_note: 核心替換：vice versa = the reverse is also true
entries.example: A successful marketing campaign benefits sales figures, and vice versa.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「反之亦然」於職場之情境：A successful marketing campaign benefits sales figures, and vice versa.

entries.collocations: damage = harm = destruction; 多義字：damage (n.) 損害; damage (v.) 破壞
entries.trap_note: 文法陷阱：damage 當『損害』時為不可數名詞！damages 複數時指『法律賠償金』！
entries.example: The courier promised to compensate for damage sustained during transit.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「賠償所造成的損失」於職場之情境：The courier promised to compensate for damage sustained during transit.

entries.collocations: accommodation = lodging = housing
entries.trap_note: 不可數名詞：accommodation（住宿）多益常考不可數！
entries.example: Travel coordinators booked luxury accommodation for the visiting delegates.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「預訂奢華住宿設施」於職場之情境：Travel coordinators booked luxury accommodation for the visiting delegates.

entries.collocations: aisle = walkway = corridor = passageway
entries.trap_note: 核心替換：aisle = walkway = corridor = passageway
entries.example: Please keep luggage clear while walking down the aircraft aisle.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「沿著走道走過去」於職場之情境：Please keep luggage clear while walking down the aircraft aisle.

entries.collocations: anticipate = foresee = expect = predict
entries.trap_note: 核心替換：anticipate = foresee = expect = predict
entries.example: Retailers must anticipate the demand for winter coats before the freeze.
entries.example_zh: 服飾零售商必須在寒流降臨前，準確預期並評估市場對冬季大衣的購買需求。

entries.collocations: attire = clothing = garments = apparel
entries.trap_note: 不可數名詞：attire 為不可數；attired (adj.) 穿著……服裝的。
entries.example: Consultants are expected to wear professional attire during client presentations.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「穿著專業商務服飾」於職場之情境：Consultants are expected to wear professional attire during client presentations.

entries.collocations: appliance = device = machine = equipment
entries.trap_note: 核心替換：appliance = device = machine = equipment
entries.example: The restaurant replaced its outdated commercial kitchen appliance.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「商用廚房家電器具」於職場之情境：The restaurant replaced its outdated commercial kitchen appliance.

entries.collocations: attired in = dressed in
entries.trap_note: 核心替換：attired in = dressed in
entries.example: All convention attendees were neatly attired in business suits.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「身著商務套裝」於職場之情境：All convention attendees were neatly attired in business suits.

entries.meaning: 團隊彼此互相（三人以上）
entries.collocations: one another = each other
entries.trap_note: 文法考點：one another 與 each other 是代名詞，通常當受詞，不能直接當主詞！
entries.example: Colleagues are encouraged to assist one another in the team during peak hours.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「團隊彼此互相（三人以上）」於職場之情境：Colleagues are encouraged to assist one another in the team during peak hours.

entries.collocations: broaden = expand = widen
entries.trap_note: 核心替換：broaden = expand = widen
entries.example: The marketing team launched campaigns to broaden client outreach in suburban districts.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「拓展客戶觸及範圍」於職場之情境：The marketing team launched campaigns to broaden client outreach in suburban districts.

entries.meaning: 達到最大容納量 / 產能
entries.collocations: capacity = volume = maximum occupancy
entries.trap_note: 核心替換：capacity = volume = maximum occupancy
entries.example: The auditorium reached maximum capacity minutes before the keynote address.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「達到最大容納量 / 產能」於職場之情境：The auditorium reached maximum capacity minutes before the keynote address.

entries.collocations: capably = competently = adeptly
entries.trap_note: 核心替換：capably = competently = adeptly
entries.example: Despite her young age, she performed tasks capably under intense deadline pressure.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「幹練稱職地執行任務」於職場之情境：Despite her young age, she performed tasks capably under intense deadline pressure.

entries.collocations: caterer = food service provider
entries.trap_note: 核心替換：caterer = food service provider
entries.example: The event coordinator decided to hire a local caterer for the banquet dinner.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「聘請當地外燴廠商」於職場之情境：The event coordinator decided to hire a local caterer for the banquet dinner.

entries.collocations: closure = shutdown = blockage
entries.trap_note: 核心替換：closure = shutdown = blockage
entries.example: Commuters were alerted to a temporary road closure along Main Street.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「臨時道路封閉」於職場之情境：Commuters were alerted to a temporary road closure along Main Street.

entries.collocations: commend = praise = applaud = compliment
entries.trap_note: 易混淆：commend (v.) 表揚讚賞 vs. comment (v./n.) 評論！
entries.example: The regional director commended the staff for exceeding quarterly sales benchmarks.
entries.example_zh: 區域總監大力表揚全體員工超越了季度銷售業績指標。

entries.collocations: competent = capable = skilled = proficient
entries.trap_note: 核心替換：competent = capable = skilled = proficient
entries.example: Hiring a competent manager helped stabilize the company's manufacturing unit.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「一位能幹稱職的經理」於職場之情境：Hiring a competent manager helped stabilize the company's manufacturing unit.

entries.collocations: comprehensive = thorough = complete = exhaustive
entries.trap_note: 易混淆：comprehensive (adj.) 全面的 vs. comprehensible (adj.) 可理解的！
entries.example: The human resources department compiled a comprehensive training guide.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「詳盡全面的培訓手冊」於職場之情境：The human resources department compiled a comprehensive training guide.

entries.collocations: conclusive = definitive = decisive
entries.trap_note: 核心替換：conclusive = definitive = decisive
entries.example: Researchers presented conclusive laboratory evidence supporting the new formula.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「決定性的實驗室證據」於職場之情境：Researchers presented conclusive laboratory evidence supporting the new formula.

entries.collocations: considerable = substantial = significant
entries.trap_note: 易混淆：considerable (adj.) 相當多的/可觀的 vs. considerate (adj.) 體貼的！
entries.example: The pharmaceutical sector achieved considerable growth over the past two quarters.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「相當可觀的成長幅度」於職場之情境：The pharmaceutical sector achieved considerable growth over the past two quarters.

entries.meaning: 當代現代化辦公室設計
entries.collocations: contemporary = modern = current
entries.trap_note: 核心替換：contemporary = modern = current
entries.example: The architecture firm specializes in sustainable and contemporary office design.
entries.example_zh: 這家建築設計事務所專精於具備永續環保理念且現代新穎的辦公空間設計。

entries.collocations: corridor = hallway = passageway
entries.trap_note: 核心替換：corridor = hallway = passageway
entries.example: Exit signs are installed along the corridor leading to the emergency stairwell.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「通往……的走廊通道」於職場之情境：Exit signs are installed along the corridor leading to the emergency stairwell.

entries.collocations: deduct = subtract = withhold
entries.trap_note: 注意：deduct 後方固定接 from！
entries.example: Health insurance premiums are automatically deducted from monthly payroll.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「從薪資中扣除」於職場之情境：Health insurance premiums are automatically deducted from monthly payroll.

entries.collocations: allocate = assign = distribute
entries.trap_note: allocate 固定搭配 to + 受詞！
entries.example: The executive board agreed to allocate additional resources to the AI research lab.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「將資源分配給」於職場之情境：The executive board agreed to allocate additional resources to the AI research lab.

entries.collocations: reliable = dependable = trustworthy
entries.trap_note: 名詞形式為 reliability！
entries.example: Apex Supplies has proven to be a highly reliable vendor over the past decade.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「可靠的供應商」於職場之情境：Apex Supplies has proven to be a highly reliable vendor over the past decade.

entries.collocations: contingent upon = dependent on = subject to
entries.trap_note: contingent 固定搭配 upon / on！
entries.example: The property acquisition is contingent upon approval from the municipal zoning board.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「取決於／視核准而定」於職場之情境：The property acquisition is contingent upon approval from the municipal zoning board.

entries.collocations: otherwise noted = unless stated differently
entries.trap_note: otherwise 為副詞，常出現在 unless otherwise [V-ed]！
entries.example: All team members must attend the weekly briefing unless otherwise noted.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「除非另有說明」於職場之情境：All team members must attend the weekly briefing unless otherwise noted.

entries.collocations: therefore = consequently = as a result
entries.trap_note: therefore 為副詞，不可直接連接兩個獨立子句（須用分號或句號）！
entries.example: Contractors are therefore required to wear safety helmets in active zones.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「因此被要求……」於職場之情境：Contractors are therefore required to wear safety helmets in active zones.

entries.collocations: renovate = remodel = refurbish = restore
entries.trap_note: 名詞形式為 renovation！
entries.example: Management authorized funds to renovate the historical training facility.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「翻新整修設施」於職場之情境：Management authorized funds to renovate the historical training facility.

entries.collocations: expedite = accelerate = hasten = speed up
entries.trap_note: 形容詞形式為 expeditious！
entries.example: The logistics team agreed to expedite the shipment for our premier client.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「加速出貨處理」於職場之情境：The logistics team agreed to expedite the shipment for our premier client.

entries.collocations: streamline = simplify = optimize
entries.trap_note: 過去分詞 streamlined 可作形容詞『精簡流線型的』！
entries.example: Digital invoicing has helped streamline the workflow across departments.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「精簡工作流程」於職場之情境：Digital invoicing has helped streamline the workflow across departments.

entries.collocations: enhance = improve = boost = augment
entries.trap_note: 名詞形式為 enhancement！
entries.example: Regular feedback sessions substantially enhance team performance.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「提升績效表現」於職場之情境：Regular feedback sessions substantially enhance team performance.

entries.collocations: revamp = overhaul = restructure
entries.trap_note: revamp 可作動詞也可直接作名詞！
entries.example: The corporate website underwent a major revamp this quarter.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「大規模改版翻新」於職場之情境：The corporate website underwent a major revamp this quarter.

entries.collocations: refurbish = recondition = upgrade
entries.trap_note: refurbished 常指出廠翻新良品！
entries.example: The company chose to refurbish old equipment rather than purchase new units.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「重新整修舊設備」於職場之情境：The company chose to refurbish old equipment rather than purchase new units.

entries.collocations: provided that = only if = on the condition that
entries.trap_note: provided that 等同 providing that，後接完整子句！
entries.example: Reimbursement will be honored provided that receipts are submitted.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「只要附有收據（前提是）」於職場之情境：Reimbursement will be honored provided that receipts are submitted.

entries.collocations: even if = even though = despite the fact that
entries.trap_note: even if 表縱使/即使！
entries.example: We will deliver the shipment even if minor delays occur at customs.
entries.example_zh: 即使在進口海關通關時發生微幅延誤，我們仍保證將如期完成貨品交付。

entries.collocations: reinforce = strengthen = bolster
entries.trap_note: 名詞形式為 reinforcement！
entries.example: Concrete pillars were added to reinforce the foundation.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「加固基礎結構」於職場之情境：Concrete pillars were added to reinforce the foundation.

entries.collocations: fulfill = execute = satisfy = meet
entries.trap_note: 名詞形式為 fulfillment！
entries.example: The vendor worked tirelessly to fulfill the obligation on time.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「履行義務/達成承諾」於職場之情境：The vendor worked tirelessly to fulfill the obligation on time.

entries.collocations: affiliate = subsidiary = partner entity
entries.trap_note: 動詞形式為 be affiliated with！
entries.example: Our branch is a regional affiliate of the parent holding company.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「……的附屬機構/子公司」於職場之情境：Our branch is a regional affiliate of the parent holding company.

entries.collocations: pressing = urgent = critical = acute
entries.trap_note: pressing 是形容詞！
entries.example: Management met behind closed doors to discuss pressing matters.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「迫切事項」於職場之情境：Management met behind closed doors to discuss pressing matters.

entries.collocations: those attending = participants = attendees
entries.trap_note: those who attend 簡化為 those attending！
entries.example: Those attending the event must wear identification badges.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「參加該活動的人員」於職場之情境：Those attending the event must wear identification badges.

entries.collocations: anyone wishing to = any candidate who wishes to
entries.trap_note: 分詞簡化句型！
entries.example: Anyone wishing to apply should submit a resume online.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「任何希望……的人」於職場之情境：Anyone wishing to apply should submit a resume online.

entries.collocations: pressing deadlines = tight schedules
entries.trap_note: 商業情境高頻語塊！
entries.example: The team worked over the weekend due to pressing deadlines.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「緊迫的截止時間」於職場之情境：The team worked over the weekend due to pressing deadlines.

entries.collocations: initiate = commence = launch = trigger
entries.trap_note: 名詞形式為 initiation 或 initiative！
entries.example: Internal auditors decided to initiate the investigation immediately.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「發起調查/啟動審查」於職場之情境：Internal auditors decided to initiate the investigation immediately.

entries.collocations: lucrative = profitable = high-yield
entries.trap_note: 常修飾 contract, deal, market！
entries.example: The firm landed a lucrative contract with a multinational telecommunications provider.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「利潤豐厚的合約」於職場之情境：The firm landed a lucrative contract with a multinational telecommunications provider.

entries.collocations: regulatory compliance = statutory adherence
entries.trap_note: 動詞為 regulate，名詞為 regulation！
entries.example: Companies must ensure regulatory compliance to avoid punitive fines.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「法規遵從/符合監管」於職場之情境：Companies must ensure regulatory compliance to avoid punitive fines.

entries.collocations: rigorous = thorough = stringent = meticulous
entries.trap_note: 副詞為 rigorously！
entries.example: All medical software undergoes rigorous testing before hospital deployment.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「嚴密嚴格的測試」於職場之情境：All medical software undergoes rigorous testing before hospital deployment.

entries.collocations: barring = except for = unless there is
entries.trap_note: barring 為介系詞，後接名詞！
entries.example: Barring any delays, the new office wing will open in October.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「除非有任何延誤」於職場之情境：Barring any delays, the new office wing will open in October.

entries.collocations: aside from = apart from = in addition to = except for
entries.trap_note: 常考除外或包含語意！
entries.example: Aside from the initial registration fee, participation is free.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「除了該費用之外」於職場之情境：Aside from the initial registration fee, participation is free.

entries.collocations: without prior notice = without advance warning
entries.trap_note: 商業合約必備語塊！
entries.example: Prices are subject to adjustment without prior notice.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「未經事先通知」於職場之情境：Prices are subject to adjustment without prior notice.

entries.collocations: prior to = before = in advance of
entries.trap_note: prior 後固定接 to + 名詞或 V-ing！
entries.example: Please review the agenda prior to the conference.
entries.example_zh: 在正式參加國際商務會議之前，請各部門代表務必先行審閱詳細大會議程。

entries.collocations: subsequent to = following = after
entries.trap_note: subsequent 後接 to！
entries.example: Subsequent to the merger, departmental operations were reorganized.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「在合併之後」於職場之情境：Subsequent to the merger, departmental operations were reorganized.

entries.collocations: following = after = subsequent to
entries.trap_note: following 作介系詞等同 after！
entries.example: Following the speech, a question-and-answer session took place.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「在演講之後」於職場之情境：Following the speech, a question-and-answer session took place.

entries.meaning: 有待董事會批准（在等待批准期間）
entries.collocations: pending = awaiting = subject to
entries.trap_note: pending 可作介系詞表『有待/在等待……期間』！
entries.example: The new product launch is pending board approval.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「有待董事會批准（在等待批准期間）」於職場之情境：The new product launch is pending board approval.

entries.collocations: acquire = purchase = take over = buy
entries.trap_note: 名詞形式為 acquisition！
entries.example: The developer secured financing to acquire the property.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「收購該不動產」於職場之情境：The developer secured financing to acquire the property.

entries.meaning: 員工職前培訓/新生訓練
entries.collocations: orientation = induction = onboarding
entries.trap_note: 動詞為 orient！
entries.example: All new hires must attend employee orientation on their first day.
entries.example_zh: 所有新進員工均必須在到職第一天參加員工職前新生培訓。

entries.collocations: prestigious = distinguished = renowned = acclaimed
entries.trap_note: 名詞形式為 prestige！
entries.example: The architect accepted a prestigious award for design excellence.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「享譽盛名的獎項」於職場之情境：The architect accepted a prestigious award for design excellence.

entries.collocations: precise = exact = accurate = meticulous
entries.trap_note: 名詞為 precision，副詞為 precisely！
entries.example: Engineers took precise measurements before cutting the steel beams.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「精確的測量數據」於職場之情境：Engineers took precise measurements before cutting the steel beams.

entries.collocations: criteria = standards = requirements = specifications
entries.trap_note: criteria 為複數，單數形為 criterion！
entries.example: Applicants must satisfy all stated eligibility criteria.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「資格審查條件」於職場之情境：Applicants must satisfy all stated eligibility criteria.

entries.collocations: precision = exactness = accuracy
entries.trap_note: 常修飾工藝或高科技製造！
entries.example: The automated arm placed the microchip with surgical precision.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「以極高精密度」於職場之情境：The automated arm placed the microchip with surgical precision.

entries.collocations: satisfy the criterion = meet the standard
entries.trap_note: criterion 為單數！
entries.example: The product failed to satisfy the crucial safety criterion.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「符合該項標準」於職場之情境：The product failed to satisfy the crucial safety criterion.

entries.collocations: in compliance with = in accordance with = adhering to
entries.trap_note: 固定片語 in compliance with！
entries.example: The facility was designed in compliance with federal guidelines.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「遵守符合……規章」於職場之情境：The facility was designed in compliance with federal guidelines.

entries.collocations: consultation = advisory session = conference
entries.trap_note: 動詞為 consult，名詞為 consultation！
entries.example: Clients may schedule a consultation with our senior tax attorneys.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「安排諮詢商談」於職場之情境：Clients may schedule a consultation with our senior tax attorneys.

entries.collocations: restrictions = limitations = constraints = caps
entries.trap_note: 動詞為 restrict！
entries.example: New trade restrictions impacted overseas consumer electronics exports.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「貿易限制規章」於職場之情境：New trade restrictions impacted overseas consumer electronics exports.

entries.collocations: remain compliant = maintain regulatory adherence
entries.trap_note: compliant 為形容詞！
entries.example: We conduct internal reviews to ensure operations remain compliant.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「始終保持合規」於職場之情境：We conduct internal reviews to ensure operations remain compliant.

entries.collocations: consult with = seek advice from = confer with
entries.trap_note: consult with + 專家對象！
entries.example: Engineers must consult with specialists before modifying blueprints.
entries.example_zh: 工程師在著手修改工程建築藍圖之前，必須先行與外部專業顧問諮詢討論。

entries.collocations: impose restrictions on = place limitations on
entries.trap_note: 動詞固定搭配 impose / place！
entries.example: The authorities chose to impose restrictions on heavy vehicle traffic.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「對……施加限制」於職場之情境：The authorities chose to impose restrictions on heavy vehicle traffic.

entries.collocations: strategic = tactical = master
entries.trap_note: 名詞為 strategy，副詞為 strategically！
entries.example: The executive committee unveiled a new strategic plan.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「策略計畫」於職場之情境：The executive committee unveiled a new strategic plan.

entries.collocations: division = department = branch = sector
entries.trap_note: 常考 corporate division！
entries.example: The logistics division handled over a million shipments.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「物流部門/事業部」於職場之情境：The logistics division handled over a million shipments.

entries.collocations: sole = exclusive = only
entries.trap_note: 副詞為 solely（僅僅/唯一地）！
entries.example: Apex is the sole distributor of this medical scanner.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「唯一經銷商/獨家代理」於職場之情境：Apex is the sole distributor of this medical scanner.

entries.collocations: protocol = procedure = code of conduct = guidelines
entries.trap_note: 複數形為 protocols！
entries.example: Personnel must adhere to strict security protocol.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「安全協定/規範規程」於職場之情境：Personnel must adhere to strict security protocol.

entries.collocations: solely responsible = exclusively in charge of
entries.trap_note: 副詞 solely 修飾形容詞！
entries.example: The project lead is solely responsible for budget oversight.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「全權負責」於職場之情境：The project lead is solely responsible for budget oversight.

entries.collocations: division = business segment
entries.trap_note: 名詞作主詞！
entries.example: Each corporate division submits monthly productivity reports.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「企業事業部」於職場之情境：Each corporate division submits monthly productivity reports.

entries.collocations: realignment = restructuring = reorganization
entries.trap_note: 商業閱讀高頻詞彙！
entries.example: The merger prompted a strategic realignment of assets.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「策略性重新配置」於職場之情境：The merger prompted a strategic realignment of assets.

entries.collocations: tangible = physical = concrete = corporeal
entries.trap_note: 反義詞為 intangible assets（無形資產）！
entries.example: Machinery and land represent tangible assets.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「有形資產」於職場之情境：Machinery and land represent tangible assets.

entries.collocations: threshold = benchmark = boundary = limit
entries.trap_note: 常考 performance threshold, credit threshold！
entries.example: Revenues must cross the threshold to qualify for subsidies.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「跨過門檻/超過界限」於職場之情境：Revenues must cross the threshold to qualify for subsidies.

entries.collocations: tenant = lessee = occupant = renter
entries.trap_note: 名詞形式為 tenancy！
entries.example: The commercial tenant executed a five-year lease.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「商用承租人/店面租戶」於職場之情境：The commercial tenant executed a five-year lease.

entries.collocations: tangible evidence = concrete proof
entries.trap_note: 高頻形容詞搭配！
entries.example: Investigators searched for tangible evidence of compliance.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「具體有形的證據」於職場之情境：Investigators searched for tangible evidence of compliance.

entries.collocations: statutory threshold = legal limit
entries.trap_note: 法規高頻語塊！
entries.example: Firms exceeding the statutory threshold must submit audits.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「法定門檻」於職場之情境：Firms exceeding the statutory threshold must submit audits.

entries.collocations: expiration = termination = end of term
entries.trap_note: 動詞形式為 expire！
entries.example: Renew your pass prior to expiration to avoid lapses.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「在到期之前」於職場之情境：Renew your pass prior to expiration to avoid lapses.

entries.collocations: vendor = supplier = contractor = merchant
entries.trap_note: 動詞為 vend（販售）！
entries.example: We order replacement valves from a certified vendor.
entries.example_zh: 我們一律直接向通過官方品質認證的特約供應商，訂購機器管線更換用閥門。

entries.collocations: invoice = bill = payment statement
entries.trap_note: 動詞形式亦為 invoice！
entries.example: The billing clerk will issue an invoice upon dispatch.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「開立發票/請款單」於職場之情境：The billing clerk will issue an invoice upon dispatch.

entries.collocations: expiration date = expiry date = validity period
entries.trap_note: 常見商務複合名詞！
entries.example: Check the expiration date stamped on the container.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「有效期限/截止日」於職場之情境：Check the expiration date stamped on the container.

entries.collocations: approved vendor = qualified contractor
entries.trap_note: 採購管理常見片語！
entries.example: Purchases must be made from the approved vendor list.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「合格供應商名單」於職場之情境：Purchases must be made from the approved vendor list.

entries.collocations: cross-reference = cross-check = compare
entries.trap_note: Part 7 雙篇三篇核心技巧！
entries.example: Always cross-reference the documents to detect discrepancies.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「交叉比對文件」於職場之情境：Always cross-reference the documents to detect discrepancies.

entries.collocations: coverage = protection = scope = insurance benefits
entries.trap_note: 亦可指 media coverage（新聞報導）！
entries.example: The policy provides comprehensive insurance coverage.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「保險理賠涵蓋範圍」於職場之情境：The policy provides comprehensive insurance coverage.

entries.collocations: condition = state = shape = order
entries.trap_note: 可指『狀態』也可指『條件』（terms and conditions）！
entries.example: The leased equipment was returned in pristine condition.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「保持完好如新的狀態」於職場之情境：The leased equipment was returned in pristine condition.

entries.collocations: in stock = available = on hand
entries.trap_note: 可指『庫存』也可指『股票』（corporate stock）！
entries.example: All replacement parts are currently in stock.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「有現貨庫存」於職場之情境：All replacement parts are currently in stock.

entries.collocations: conduct = carry out = perform = execute
entries.trap_note: 可作動詞『實施』也可作名詞『行為/操守』！
entries.example: External accountants will conduct an audit next week.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「進行審計調查」於職場之情境：External accountants will conduct an audit next week.

entries.collocations: address = resolve = tackle = deal with
entries.trap_note: 可作動詞『處理/演說』也可作名詞『地址/演講』！
entries.example: The committee met to address the issue of delays.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「處理/解決問題」於職場之情境：The committee met to address the issue of delays.

entries.collocations: media coverage = press reporting
entries.trap_note: 商業情境高頻詞義！
entries.example: The product launch received widespread media coverage.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「媒體報導/新聞宣傳」於職場之情境：The product launch received widespread media coverage.

entries.collocations: on condition that = provided that
entries.trap_note: 常用於商務合約前提！
entries.example: The loan was approved on condition that records be audited.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「在……條件下/前提是」於職場之情境：The loan was approved on condition that records be audited.

entries.collocations: cross-check = reconcile = compare = corroborate
entries.trap_note: Part 7 多篇閱讀必備技巧！
entries.example: Auditors cross-check the data to verify invoice accuracy.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「交叉核對數據」於職場之情境：Auditors cross-check the data to verify invoice accuracy.

entries.collocations: amendment = revision = modification = addendum
entries.trap_note: 動詞為 amend！
entries.example: Both parties signed a contract amendment yesterday.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「合約修正案/補充條款」於職場之情境：Both parties signed a contract amendment yesterday.

entries.collocations: written confirmation = documented proof = written verification
entries.trap_note: 動詞為 confirm！
entries.example: We require written confirmation before dispatching goods.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「書面確認函/證實」於職場之情境：We require written confirmation before dispatching goods.

entries.collocations: detect an error = identify a mistake
entries.trap_note: 動詞片語！
entries.example: Software sensors detect an error in the circuit board.
entries.example_zh: 精密的軟體診斷感測器，在電路基板運作過程中敏銳偵測到了一處計算錯誤。

entries.collocations: billing statement = account statement
entries.trap_note: 常見商務財務文件！
entries.example: The billing statement reflects all promotional discounts.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「帳單對帳單」於職場之情境：The billing statement reflects all promotional discounts.

entries.collocations: reverse elimination = process of elimination
entries.trap_note: TOEIC Part 7 核心高分策略！
entries.example: Apply reverse elimination to find the NOT question answer.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「反向排除法」於職場之情境：Apply reverse elimination to find the NOT question answer.

entries.collocations: adhere to = abide by = comply with = conform to ｜ 延伸語塊：adhere strictly to（嚴格遵守……規程；adhere strictly to = abide rigorously by）
entries.trap_note: adhere 固定接 to！ ｜ 必考介系詞 to！
entries.example: Personnel must adhere strictly to the rules.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「嚴格遵守……規章」於職場之情境：Personnel must adhere strictly to the rules.

entries.collocations: in accordance with = in compliance with
entries.trap_note: 固定商務法務片語！
entries.example: The audit was conducted in accordance with national laws.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「依照/根據……規定」於職場之情境：The audit was conducted in accordance with national laws.

entries.collocations: under the supervision of = supervised by
entries.trap_note: 名詞形式為 supervision！
entries.example: Interns work under the supervision of senior researchers.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「在……監督指導下」於職場之情境：Interns work under the supervision of senior researchers.

entries.collocations: substantially = significantly = considerably = vastly
entries.trap_note: 副詞修飾動詞！
entries.example: The new product will substantially boost revenue.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「大幅提升營收」於職場之情境：The new product will substantially boost revenue.

entries.collocations: hold off on = postpone = delay = defer
entries.trap_note: 片語動詞！
entries.example: We decided to hold off on the project until next quarter.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「暫緩擱置該專案」於職場之情境：We decided to hold off on the project until next quarter.

entries.collocations: eligible for = qualified for = entitled to
entries.trap_note: 必考介系詞 for！
entries.example: Only full-time staff are eligible for the award.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「符合獲獎資格」於職場之情境：Only full-time staff are eligible for the award.

entries.collocations: allocate time wisely = budget time efficiently
entries.trap_note: 實戰考試必備配速心法！
entries.example: Pacing requires candidates to allocate time wisely.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「明智分配時間」於職場之情境：Pacing requires candidates to allocate time wisely.

entries.collocations: trust visual anchors = rely on visual grammatical markers
entries.trap_note: 25 天特訓核心心法！
entries.example: In Part 5, trust visual anchors to eliminate guesswork.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「信任視覺錨點」於職場之情境：In Part 5, trust visual anchors to eliminate guesswork.

entries.meaning: 勇奪 860+ 多益金色證書
entries.collocations: achieve 860+ = earn the golden credential
entries.trap_note: 衝刺終極目標！
entries.example: With steady practice, you will achieve 860+ golden certificate.
entries.example_zh: 該句體現「勇奪 860+ 多益金色證書」於職場之情境：With steady practice, you will achieve 860+ golden certificate.

entries.collocations: outline the strategic roadmap (概述戰略藍圖) ｜ as outlined in the proposal (如提案所述)
entries.trap_note: 常作後位修飾分詞（the strategy outlined in the report），勿與 outline（動詞原形／名詞）混淆。
entries.example: As outlined in the corporate restructuring proposal, the research division will receive additional funding.
entries.example_zh: 如企業組織重組提案中所述，研發核心部門將依序獲得額外的專案挹注資金。

entries.meaning: 根據要求、索取即給（備索）
entries.collocations: available upon request (索取即給) ｜ provided upon request
entries.trap_note: 商業書信高頻短語，固定搭配介系詞 upon 或 on（upon request 等同於 on request）。
entries.example: The detailed product catalog and wholesale price list are available upon request from our sales representatives.
entries.example_zh: 詳細產品規格型錄與大宗批發價目表，可隨時向我們的區域業務代表索取備索。

entries.meaning: 緊湊小巧的、精簡的；協定、合約
entries.collocations: compact vehicle (小型車) ｜ compact office layout (緊湊精簡的辦公室格局)
entries.trap_note: 形容詞表體積精簡省空間；名詞可表正式條約或小型車。
entries.example: The startup opted for a compact office layout to minimize overhead expenses during its initial year of operation.
entries.example_zh: 這家新創科技公司選擇了緊湊精簡的辦公室格局，以將營運首年的管理開銷降至最低。

entries.pos: 及物動詞 / 可數名詞 (v./n.)
entries.meaning: 實施、貫徹執行；器具、工具
entries.collocations: implement new safety regulations (實施工安新規) ｜ implement corporate policy
entries.trap_note: 作動詞必接政策、措施等受詞；名詞 implementation 表「執行實施」。
entries.example: The human resources department will implement new remote-work guidelines starting on the first of next month.
entries.example_zh: 人力資源部門將自下個月初起，正式在全公司實施最新修訂的遠距工作管理規章。

entries.collocations: corporate staff directory (企業員工通訊錄) ｜ telephone directory
entries.trap_note: 切勿與 direct（動詞／形容詞）或 direction（方向／指示）混淆。
entries.example: New employees can find contact information for department supervisors in the internal staff directory.
entries.example_zh: 新進到職同仁可在內部企業通訊錄中，迅速查閱各部門主管與同事的聯絡方式。

entries.collocations: omit unnecessary details from the executive report ｜ omit items
entries.trap_note: 過去式及分詞須重複 t（omitted）；名詞為 omission（疏忽／遺漏）。
entries.example: Please make sure not to omit any travel expenses when submitting your reimbursement form.
entries.example_zh: 在提交差旅核銷申請表單時，請務必再三確認不要遺漏填報任何實際發生的差旅費用。

entries.collocations: voice-over narration for the promotional video (宣傳片旁白口述)
entries.trap_note: 動詞為 narrate（敘述、配旁白）；narrator 為「旁白員、敘述者」。
entries.example: The multimedia marketing team hired a professional actor to provide the voice-over narration for the new commercial.
entries.example_zh: 多媒體數位行銷團隊聘請了專業外配音員，為最新發布的宣傳短片錄製旁白口述。

entries.meaning: 感激的；有義務的、被迫的
entries.collocations: feel obliged to assist colleagues (覺得有義務協助同事) ｜ be obliged to comply
entries.trap_note: be obliged to + V 表示「依法或道義上有義務做某事」；much obliged 表「非常感激」。
entries.example: Under the terms of the confidentiality agreement, contractors are obliged to protect proprietary client data.
entries.example_zh: 依據雙方簽訂的嚴格保密條款，合約承包商在道義與法規上有義務全力保護客戶的專有資料。

entries.collocations: have a profound impact on quarterly market demand (對季度市場需求產生深遠影響)
entries.trap_note: 修飾影響力、見解或變革（profound impact / influence / changes）。
entries.example: The introduction of artificial intelligence tools has had a profound impact on customer support operations.
entries.example_zh: 人工智慧創新工具的全面導入，對整體客戶支援與售後服務流程產生了深遠巨大的變革影響。

entries.collocations: Customer applications must be processed manually (必須手動審核申請)
entries.trap_note: 與 automatically（自動地）構成反義對比；形容詞為 manual（手動的／手冊）。
entries.example: Customer purchase orders received by fax must be verified and entered into the database manually.
entries.example_zh: 凡是透過紙本傳真方式遞送的客戶採購訂單，皆必須由專責人員以人工手動方式核對並輸入系統。

entries.meaning: 輸送帶、傳送設備 (廠房/機場高頻)
entries.collocations: baggage conveyor belt (行李輸送帶) ｜ assembly conveyor system
entries.trap_note: 多益聽力 Part 1 與閱讀倉儲高頻場景詞，常接 belt 構成 conveyor belt。
entries.example: Maintenance crews shut down the luggage conveyor belt for two hours to replace a worn motor.
entries.example_zh: 航廈維修工程人員將行李輸送帶暫停運作兩小時，以全面檢修並更換老舊磨損的驅動馬達。

entries.pos: 及物動詞 / 可數名詞 (v./n.)
entries.collocations: hoist the shipping container onto the freight vessel (將貨櫃吊上貨船)
entries.trap_note: 多益聽力圖片題常考「吊車正在吊起建材」（A crane is hoisting materials）。
entries.example: Dockworkers used an industrial crane to hoist heavy cargo containers onto the outgoing freighter.
entries.example_zh: 碼頭裝卸作業人員操作重型起重機，將巨大的貨櫃平穩吊起並安置至即將出港的遠洋貨輪上。

entries.meaning: 利用、使用、善加利用 (=make use of)
entries.collocations: fully utilize underperforming commercial assets (充分利用效益不彰之資產)
entries.trap_note: 比 use 更正式，常用於商務資源或產能的最佳化（utilize resources / capacity）。
entries.example: The logistics manager suggested utilizing regional storage depots to reduce cross-country shipping times.
entries.example_zh: 物流統籌經理提出具體建言，主張善加利用效益未達預期的區域閒置倉儲，以有效縮短跨區運送耗時。

entries.collocations: complimentary airport shuttle service (免費機場接駁服務)
entries.trap_note: 常與 complimentary（免費的）連用，指飯店或會場之往返接駁車。
entries.example: Guests staying at the resort hotel can take advantage of a complimentary shuttle service to the train station.
entries.example_zh: 凡下榻該海濱度假飯店的貴賓，均可全額免費搭乘往返於鄰近高鐵車站的定時接駁專車服務。

entries.meaning: 騷擾 (職場人資規章必備核心詞)
entries.collocations: strict workplace harassment policy (反職場騷擾嚴格政策)
entries.trap_note: 動詞為 harass（騷擾）；注意不可數名詞屬性，前不加 a 亦無複數。
entries.example: All newly hired managers are required to complete an annual training seminar on preventing workplace harassment.
entries.example_zh: 全體新晉管理幹部均被嚴格要求必須每年完成防止職場騷擾與營造友善工作環境的專案培訓研討會。

entries.meaning: 應負責任的、有說明的義務 (=responsible)
entries.collocations: Managers are held accountable for project budget overruns (經理需對預算超支負責)
entries.trap_note: 必考固定搭配：be held accountable for + N（對某事負起責任）。
entries.example: Project leads are held directly accountable for ensuring their teams meet quarterly project deadlines.
entries.example_zh: 專案專職經理需承擔直接監督責任，對確保整個團隊能準時達成季度專案進度截止日全面負責。

entries.meaning: 最佳的、最優的、最適宜的
entries.collocations: achieve optimal efficiency during peak manufacturing hours (達到最優效率)
entries.trap_note: 同義字為 optimum；副詞為 optimally（最適化地）。
entries.example: The ventilation system was recalibrated to maintain optimal temperature conditions in the server room.
entries.example_zh: 機房通風空調系統已經重新校準，以在伺服器高乘載運作時維持最優良最適宜的恆溫濕度環境。

entries.collocations: conduct an on-site inspection of the facility (實施廠區實地檢查)
entries.trap_note: 常與 inspection（檢查）、daycare（托兒設施）、parking（現場停車）連用。
entries.example: Safety compliance auditors conducted an on-site inspection of the chemical manufacturing plant.
entries.example_zh: 工業安全法規稽核員今日親赴化學原料製造工廠，展開全面且嚴謹的現場實地安全檢查作業。

entries.meaning: 住宿膳宿；適應調解 (雙c雙m必考拼寫)
entries.collocations: provide premium hotel accommodations for overseas clients (提供頂級飯店住宿)
entries.trap_note: 美式英語常以複數 accommodations 表住宿；注意拼法為雙 c 雙 m。
entries.example: The conference registration fee covers admission to all breakout sessions and luxury hotel accommodations.
entries.example_zh: 本次國際論壇之全額報名費，已包含全天候分案專題演講入場資格與特約豪華五星飯店住宿膳宿。

entries.collocations: support our future commercial endeavors in foreign markets (支持海外商業拓展努力)
entries.trap_note: 動詞時常接不定詞：endeavor to do sth（竭力做某事）。
entries.example: The executive committee wished Mr. Tanaka great success in his future entrepreneurial endeavors.
entries.example_zh: 全體執行董事會成員同聲祝福田中先生在未來開拓海外市場的全新商業努力與創業嘗試中大獲成功。

entries.collocations: submit receipts for travel expense reimbursement (提交單據以核銷差旅費)
entries.trap_note: 及物動詞為 reimburse（核銷／退還）；reimburse sb for expenses。
entries.example: Employees seeking travel expense reimbursement must attach original receipts to their claim forms.
entries.example_zh: 凡欲申請公出代墊差旅費用核銷之同仁，送件時務必檢附各項交通與餐飲之原始統一發票收據單據。

entries.collocations: retrieve archived invoices from the cloud server (從雲端取回封存發票)
entries.trap_note: 多益資訊系統題高頻詞，名詞為 retrieval（檢索取回）。
entries.example: The updated accounting database enables staff to retrieve historical sales transactions in seconds.
entries.example_zh: 全新升級後的雲端會計資料庫，讓財務同仁能夠在短短幾秒鐘之內立即檢索並取回歷史封存發票憑證。

entries.collocations: run administrative errands for the department head (為部門主管奔走處理公事)
entries.trap_note: 固定動詞搭配為 run errands（奔走辦事），不可與 task 或 chore 誤搭配。
entries.example: The administrative assistant left the office briefly to run several banking errands before noon.
entries.example_zh: 行政部門助理同仁在中午用餐之前短暫外出，專程為部門主管奔走處理數筆緊急的銀行往來公幹雜事。

entries.collocations: have a passing acquaintance with commercial real estate ｜ make sb's acquaintance
entries.trap_note: 動詞為 acquaint（使熟悉）；be acquainted with sth 表「熟悉某事物」。
entries.example: Ms. Chen made the acquaintance of several prospective investors during the networking dinner.
entries.example_zh: 陳專案副理在昨晚的商業交流聯誼餐會中，有幸結識了數名對我司產品展現濃厚興趣的潛在投資人熟人。

entries.meaning: 便利設施、生活休閒設施 (飯店/社區必考)
entries.collocations: luxury hotel amenities including a heated pool and sauna (頂級飯店休閒設施)
entries.trap_note: 多益常以複數 amenities 出現，指泳池、健身房、商務中心等附屬便利設施。
entries.example: The residential complex offers modern amenities such as an on-site fitness center and bicycle storage.
entries.example_zh: 這處全新完工的頂級住宅綜合社區，配備了各項齊全的生活便利設施，包括駐點健身房與溫水游泳池。

entries.collocations: have the privilege of introducing our keynote speaker (有幸介紹我們的主講嘉賓)
entries.trap_note: 商務演講開場固定客套句：It is a privilege to welcome you all。
entries.example: It is an honor and a privilege to introduce Dr. Vance as our keynote speaker this morning.
entries.example_zh: 今天早晨能夠由我代表全體大會，向在場各位隆重介紹我們萬分敬佩的主講嘉賓凡斯博士，實屬無上殊榮。

entries.collocations: take decisive action to curb inflation and budget deficits (採取果斷行動)
entries.trap_note: 動詞為 decide；副詞 decisively（果斷地）；名詞 decision（決定）。
entries.example: The board commended the CEO for taking decisive action during the recent supply chain crisis.
entries.example_zh: 全體監察人與董事會高度肯定執行長在面對突如其來的供應鏈中斷危機時，所迅速採取的果斷決策行動。

entries.collocations: robust economic expansion ｜ robust cybersecurity software (穩健的資安防護軟體)
entries.trap_note: 修飾經濟成長（robust growth）或系統架構（robust infrastructure）。
entries.example: Despite global economic volatility, the multinational retail chain reported robust revenue growth.
entries.example_zh: 即便面對全球總體經濟情勢的高度不確定性，該跨國連鎖通路集團依然繳出了營收強健穩步擴張的佳績。

entries.collocations: display a tendency to overspend in the final quarter (呈現過度支出傾向)
entries.trap_note: 動詞為 tend（tend to + V 傾向於做某事）；名詞常搭配介系詞 towards 或 to-V。
entries.example: Consumer survey data shows a noticeable tendency among commuters to switch to electric vehicles.
entries.example_zh: 最新的市場消費行為分析報告顯示，年輕通勤族群正呈現出逐漸轉向選購純電動代步車輛的明顯趨勢傾向。

entries.meaning: 排除、排斥在外、免責條款
entries.collocations: exclusion of liability outlined in the warranty clause (保固條款中所述之免責排除)
entries.trap_note: 及物動詞為 exclude；形容詞 exclusive（專屬的／排他的）；exclusion clause（免責條款）。
entries.example: Customers should carefully review the warranty terms regarding the exclusion of accidental water damage.
entries.example_zh: 所有購買本產品之消費者，均應詳加審閱保固合約手冊中關於排除天然意外與進水損害之各項免責條款。

entries.collocations: avoid needless repetition in the business proposal (避免企劃案中不必要的重複贅述)
entries.trap_note: 動詞為 repeat；形容詞 repetitive（重複乏味的）；切勿混淆拼寫。
entries.example: The editor recommended cutting several redundant paragraphs to avoid needless repetition.
entries.example_zh: 資深審查編輯強烈建議刪除提案中數個語意重疊的贅述段落，以徹底避免商務企劃書中不必要的冗言重複。

entries.pos: 可數 / 不可數名詞、動詞 (n./v.)
entries.collocations: conflict of interest (利益衝突，合約審計高頻) ｜ schedule conflict (行程衝突)
entries.trap_note: 多益商務審計必考片語：a conflict of interest（利益衝突）。
entries.example: Employees must sign a disclosure agreement to prevent any potential conflict of interest.
entries.example_zh: 所有新進專業人員在簽約入職前均須完成簽署利益揭露書，以確保能全面杜絕日後任何潛在之商業利益衝突。

entries.meaning: 易受...影響；須經...核准；視...而定
entries.collocations: The tour itinerary is subject to change without notice (行程如有變更恕不另行通知)
entries.trap_note: 多益合約與通知最高頻片語！to 為介系詞，後接名詞（subject to approval / change）。
entries.example: All discounted airfare rates are subject to seat availability and seasonal peak surcharges.
entries.example_zh: 所有促銷特惠機票的折扣費率均須視當下機位訂位狀況而定，且可能隨旺季附加費用隨時變動調整。

entries.collocations: annual employee performance appraisal (年度員工績效考評)
entries.trap_note: 動詞為 appraise（考核／評估）；注意勿與 apprise（通知告知）混淆。
entries.example: Human resources conducts an annual employee performance appraisal every November.
entries.example_zh: 人力資源發展部固定於每年十一月第一週，正式在全公司各事業處全面推展年度員工績效考評作業。

entries.collocations: government appropriation for public transit development (大眾運輸預算撥款)
entries.trap_note: 動詞 appropriate 表「撥出款項」或「挪用」；形容詞 appropriate 表「適當的」。
entries.example: The municipal legislature approved a special budget appropriation to modernize urban drainage systems.
entries.example_zh: 市政議會於昨晚表決通過了一筆特別公共預算撥款，專門用以加速推動老舊都會地下排水防洪工程現代化。

entries.meaning: 聚合、集成、匯總 (數據/資訊)
entries.collocations: automated data aggregation platform for market research (市場研究自動數據匯總平台)
entries.trap_note: 及物動詞 aggregate（匯總／聚集）；形容詞 aggregate 表「總計的」。
entries.example: The business intelligence tool performs real-time data aggregation across all retail outlets.
entries.example_zh: 這款先進的商業智慧分析系統，能夠在幕後全自動執行跨越全省兩百家零售實體門市的即時營業數據匯總。

entries.collocations: express sincere appreciation (表達誠摯謝意) ｜ currency appreciation (貨幣升值)
entries.trap_note: 一詞多義代表：(1) 感謝（in appreciation of）；(2) 資產或貨幣升值（反義 depreciation）。
entries.example: The general manager expressed his sincere appreciation to the entire engineering division for their hard work.
entries.example_zh: 事業群總經理在季會中發表感言，向全體工程研發團隊日以繼夜的辛勤付出與技術突破表達最誠摯的感謝。

entries.collocations: investigate exaggerated advertising claims made by competitors (調查競爭對手誇大不實之廣告宣稱)
entries.trap_note: 動詞 exaggerate（誇大吹噓）；名詞 exaggeration（誇大）。
entries.example: The consumer protection bureau fined the vendor for publishing exaggerated promotional claims.
entries.example_zh: 公平交易與消費者保護主管機關，針對競爭同業在社群媒體上刊發誇大不實之療效促銷宣稱正式立案展開調查。

entries.meaning: 雜項的、形形色色的、混雜的
entries.collocations: allocate petty cash for miscellaneous office expenses (提撥零用金作為雜項辦公支出)
entries.trap_note: 財務報表常用 miscellaneous expenses（雜支費用）。
entries.example: The finance department allocated a modest fund for miscellaneous stationery and catering expenses.
entries.example_zh: 公司財務會計部門特別核准提撥了一筆零用金備用專款，以支應日常採購文具紙張與各項雜項辦公行政支出。

entries.collocations: face severe disciplinary action for violating privacy rules (因違反隱私法規面臨嚴厲懲處)
entries.trap_note: 常見搭配：disciplinary action / measures / penalty（紀律懲戒處分）。
entries.example: Any employee who shares proprietary source code will face immediate disciplinary proceedings.
entries.example_zh: 凡經查證屬實擅自對外傳播外洩公司內部未公開軟體專利核心原始碼者，將面臨即刻且嚴厲的紀律懲戒處分。

entries.collocations: international trade delegation representing renewable energy (綠能國際貿易代表團)
entries.trap_note: 指代表團時為可數名詞；指「授權」時為不可數名詞（delegation of authority）。
entries.example: A senior commercial delegation will arrive tomorrow to discuss bilateral export agreements.
entries.example_zh: 一支由歐洲綠能知名專家與企業領袖組成的國際跨國貿易代表團，即將於明日抵達我國展開參訪交流。

entries.collocations: small business proprietors affected by supply bottlenecks (受供應瓶頸衝擊的小企業主)
entries.trap_note: 單數為 proprietor；proprietorship 表獨資企業；與 landlord / owner 同義。
entries.example: Local shop proprietors formed an alliance to lobby for reduced municipal commercial taxes.
entries.example_zh: 多位深受原物料物流延誤衝擊的在地小企業獨資經營業主，聯合組成互助陣線向主管機關爭取營運紓困。

entries.collocations: promptly rectify the billing error on the final invoice (迅速修正發票帳務錯誤)
entries.trap_note: 正式商業書信動詞，rectify an error / mistake / situation。
entries.example: The billing department worked overtime to rectify the software glitch before issuing monthly invoices.
entries.example_zh: 客戶服務與計費管理團隊全員加班排查，務求在今日下班正式寄發每月帳單前，迅速矯正修正軟體系統計算錯誤。

entries.meaning: 可以說、按理說、論證上（等於 reasonably）
entries.collocations: arguably the most innovative financial technology platform (可說是最新穎的金融科技平台)
entries.trap_note: 常用於修飾最高級形容詞（arguably the best / most effective）。
entries.example: The newly opened medical research facility is arguably the most advanced center of its kind in Asia.
entries.example_zh: 這座甫於上個月正式剪綵啟用的頂尖臨床醫學科技園區，論證上堪稱是全亞洲規模最龐大且設備最新穎的中心。

entries.collocations: streamline global logistics management to lower shipping costs (精簡全球物流管理以降低運費)
entries.trap_note: 字尾恆有 s，指整個物流學科或運作體系時視為單數或複數，logistics hub（物流樞紐）。
entries.example: By consolidating warehousing hubs, the firm streamlined its overseas logistics network.
entries.example_zh: 透過大刀闊斧整併既有的區域倉儲節點，該製造集團成功精簡了跨國海陸空物流後勤運籌體系，有效節省運費。

entries.meaning: 經由、透過、取道 (=by way of / by means of)
entries.collocations: official documents will be delivered via express courier (官方文件將透過快捷快遞遞送)
entries.trap_note: 介系詞，後接交通方式、通訊管道或中停地點（via email / via Frankfurt）。
entries.example: All confidential contract drafts should be transmitted via encrypted file transfer rather than regular email.
entries.example_zh: 所有涉及核心商業機密的合作備忘錄與正式合約最終定稿，均應透過受高強度金鑰保護的專用檔案通道遞送。

entries.meaning: 分支機構、業務部門、機構之分支
entries.collocations: the research arm of the multinational conglomerate (跨國企業集團之研發機構)
entries.trap_note: 商務偏義字！除了「手臂」外，多益常考「分支業務單位（an investigative / commercial arm）」。
entries.example: The commercial banking arm of the financial group recorded a thirty percent rise in net profits.
entries.example_zh: 該跨國大型綜合企業集團旗下專責先進醫藥研發的海外業務分支機構，於昨日正式宣布獲得國際專利授權。

entries.collocations: a quiet residential suburb located outside the metropolis (位於大都市外的寧靜住宅郊區)
entries.trap_note: 形容詞為 suburban（郊區的）；in the suburbs 表「在郊區居住」。
entries.example: Many families choose to live in the green suburbs and commute into the financial center by light rail.
entries.example_zh: 許多在市中心金融商務特區服務的高階白領家庭，寧可選擇安居在綠樹成蔭的寧靜住宅郊區，兼顧生活品質。

entries.meaning: 更不用說、何況 (專用於否定遞進)
entries.collocations: The firm cannot afford rent, let alone purchase equipment (公司連房租都付不起，更不用說買設備)
entries.trap_note: 重要文法片語！出現在否定句或表缺乏（lack / barely）之後，強調更不可能發生的情況。
entries.example: The cash-strapped startup could barely afford office rent, let alone hire full-time legal counsel.
entries.example_zh: 這家資金極度困窘的新創團隊目前連繳交共享辦公室租金都捉襟見肘，更不用說大手筆額外聘請常年法律顧問了。

entries.meaning: 深思熟慮的、明智知情的；見多識廣的
entries.collocations: consult an advisor to make an informed financial decision (諮詢顧問以做出明智知情的財務決策)
entries.trap_note: 多益必考搭配詞：make an informed decision / choice。informative 則是形容事物提供豐富資訊。
entries.example: Consumers are encouraged to consult certified financial planners before making an informed investment decision.
entries.example_zh: 專業財經專家極力倡導，廣大投資人在簽署購買複雜金融商品前，務必諮詢持牌顧問以做出深思熟慮的明智決策。

entries.meaning: 多樣的、各式各樣的、形形色色的
entries.collocations: a varied selection of imported specialty coffees (多樣化的進口特調咖啡選品)
entries.trap_note: 修飾單數集合名詞 selection / assortment 時用 varied；various 則直接修飾複數名詞。
entries.example: The international food market offers a varied selection of organic cheeses and artisanal breads.
entries.example_zh: 該高檔國際精品進口食品選品店，每日均為高端饕客陳列並提供多樣化且種類繁多的歐陸手工特調咖啡與乳酪。

entries.meaning: 反對的、抗拒的 (固定搭配介系詞 to)
entries.collocations: Community leaders are firmly opposed to the commercial zoning (社區領袖強烈反對商業分區)
entries.trap_note: 固定搭配：be opposed to + N / V-ing（to 為介系詞）。主動 oppose 則直接接受詞。
entries.example: Several neighborhood associations are firmly opposed to the proposed industrial zoning expansion.
entries.example_zh: 該行政區境內的數個主要在地居民自治協會，正聯合採取堅定立場，公開表達強烈反對此項新商業分區開發案。

entries.meaning: 長期的、持久的、被拖長的
entries.collocations: prolonged droughts (長期乾旱) ｜ prolonged negotiations (持久談判)
entries.trap_note: 由過去分詞轉化之形容詞，修飾談判、延遲或乾旱等持續很久的事件。
entries.example: Following prolonged negotiations, the two pharmaceutical giants finally agreed on the merger terms.
entries.example_zh: 在歷經了長達數個月勞資雙方緊湊且艱辛的馬拉松式持久談判後，這場重大罷工工潮終於迎來了和解的曙光。

entries.collocations: principal objective of the marketing campaign (行銷活動之核心首要目標)
entries.trap_note: 商務名詞表「目標」（primary / principal objective）；作形容詞表「客觀的」（objective analysis）。
entries.example: The primary objective of the corporate restructuring is to accelerate product development cycles.
entries.example_zh: 此項由董事會主導之跨部門營運精簡重組計畫，其最關鍵的核心首要目標，就是力求縮短新產品推向市場的週期。
